evidence_paraphrase: Confidential discussions since 2018 included drug assets and partnerships. A 2020 proposed program collaboration included a 19.9 percent equity investment, not target control. Earlier program acquisition proposals and licensing discussions were not whole-company acquisitions. At January 1 there was no definitive whole-company agreement. The first Merck private whole-company proposal came February 7, 2021; negotiations increased consideration to 60 dollars cash. The parties executed February 24 at approximately 10:45 p.m. Eastern and publicly announced February 25 before Nasdaq trading. The tender commenced March 4.
